notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
A major update.



Improved game play, extra special effects and overall feel of the game has been revamped.



An extra 3 levels have been added as well.



Enjoy !!!

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.notes: The game play has been improved as well as many new special effects and added features.

notes.title: Hunting Pearl Creek Update
notes.notes: Pickup effects added, Muzzle flash added, Fixed high score announcement, Fixed water wave issue, Virtual key controls updated, Defined peppermint plants better, Firewood is now outlined, Fixed snow control on pause, Added a visual hit indicator to enemies and shootable objects, Added a dynamite throw indicator, Added extra health points, Improved bat response, Improved rain effects.
